mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_baby_info (email, baby_name, birth_date, gender, profile_image_file_name, blood_type, birth_week_count, birth_weight, birth_height, head_circumference) VALUES (#{email}, #{babyInfo.babyName}, #{babyInfo.birthDate}, #{babyInfo.gender}, #{babyInfo.profileImageFileName}, #{babyInfo.bloodType}, #{babyInfo.birthWeekCount}, #{babyInfo.birthWeight}, #{babyInfo.birthHeight}, #{babyInfo.headCircumference})
mapper.update: UPDATE tbl_baby_info SET baby_name = #{babyInfo.babyName}, birth_date = #{babyInfo.birthDate}, gender = #{babyInfo.gender}, profile_image_file_name = #{babyInfo.profileImageFileName}, blood_type = #{babyInfo.bloodType}, birth_week_count = #{babyInfo.birthWeekCount}, birth_weight = #{babyInfo.birthWeight}, birth_height = #{babyInfo.birthHeight}, head_circumference = #{babyInfo.headCircumference} WHERE baby_no = #{babyInfo.babyNo} AND email = #{email}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM tbl_baby_info WHERE baby_no = #{babyNo} AND email = #{email}
